question: Why OpenHOI3's Britain sent neither Royal Marines division at the war's start.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas
addresses.comment: **Rebuilds the ranked areas to invade at CEU3AI +0xC8** (nodes {area, score, distance, prev +0xC, next +0x10, byte +0x14}, kept by descending score through 0x49C240). Read whole, 0x895530 to `ret 8` at 0x8971B2. The list is freed first; nothing more unless UnitList_SumTransportCapacity(country units +0xBAC) >= 4 x infantry_brigade weight/1000. Candidates: an AI country takes every area (CCountry +0xD30) of every country in its enemies list (+0x1008) that is in_scenario, the area not landlocked - except that GER, when COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea (0x7FD90) says its acting capital's area borders an enemy, considers only NOR, SWE, FIN, DEN; and when both we and the enemy are in a real faction (slot 7), never FIN and never the acting capital area of ROM, BUL or YUG. With an agent: the areas of the agent unit's plan objectives (CUnit +0x234) that are real, not ours, held by a friend or an enemy, not landlocked and holding none of the agent's front provinces (+0xC0). Reach: our areas, plus every non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) country's areas unless our capital's area borders an enemy; range 2000 if it does, else 5000. For each candidate A (controller C): over its non-landlocked neighbour areas B - B ours: A 'touches us', and B (unless our acting capital's area) goes on a list of staging areas; B held by X != C where A is C's acting capital area, X a friend (IsFriend false-flag), at war with C (or REB, or an undeclared war covering B's first province), not played, in our faction where both are in real ones, B's region group not our capital's, and (X our subject, or we are not JAP and X not JAP/POL/DEN, X no one else's subject): A 'touches us' and B is a staging area. Then: A in the failed list (+0x94) skips; an AI country's A that touches us goes on the failed list; CEU3AI_MayInvadeArea false -> failed; some port of A must reach (0xD52A0, flag 0) a port q of a reach area within range (int(float(naval distance/1000)) < range), q in our area, in ENG's acting capital area, or reachable within range from one of our own ports - else failed. Score: 100001 for an area holding a priority province (+0x118); else, a small island (ports' level_max summing >= 1, < 5 provinces, no land neighbour +0x3C) gives GER -99 before 1944 and otherwise 10 x port levels + 51; C's acting capital area gives min(provinces,100) + 1, halved when C is a subject; else 1. +900 for C = GER when the Soviet Union owns provinces and has surrender progress > 300 or manpower < 90, we being major or max_ic > 100, and A GER's capital area; USA vs JAP +200 (+600 more for a small island) unless that Soviet test held; JAP: vs USA small island +600, HOL +200, PHI +100. Then g = 120 for each of the map defines GIBRALTAR_BLOCKER and SUEZ_BLOCKER whose province lies in A (ENG and USA only), plus over A's first 60 provinces: 8 x naval base level_max, +40 with victory points, +30 yielding crude oil/metal/energy/rare materials, +40 with a strategic resource (+0x18 slot 14), +5 owned by us; g / (n/20) when n/20 > 1. total = g + f; k = max(fistp(total/5), 5) (6 or more kept); score = total + MT19937Next(AI generator) % k, divided by (0x81880(A, our capital area)/200) when that is positive, rounded by fistp. Kept to 10 by dropping the tail. Then staging areas: the priority areas held by a same-side or non-hostile (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) non-enemy country are added; each not failed must pass AreaPair_SeaRouteOpen (0xD5760) (some port of our capital area reaches one of its ports while we are at war; always at peace) or goes on the failed list; one of ours needs >= 40 provinces in enemy-held neighbour areas (25 when one of them is its controller's capital area); score 500, or 10500 for a priority area, + AI-generator draw % max(fistp(score/5),5) - 5 x provinces, x2 for a controller's acting capital area; inserted with distance 0. Finally, entries scoring under the head's score / 10 are dropped from the tail. **Its draw (0x496A0B) is MT19937Next on the game state's +0x124**, the AI's generator and not the static one battles draw on (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59). **The staging step and the final cut read on the listing, 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): the priority areas are those of +0x118's provinces in first-seen order (0x495AFA); the holder test is IsSameSide or co-belligerent (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) and not IsEnemyTag, rebels skipped (0x496B42); the own-area count is of neighbours at war, rebels or under an undeclared war covering their first province (0x496D1D); s = 500.0 or 10500.0, k = max(fistp(s/5.0),5), the draw inline (0x496F5A, signed), less 5 x provinces, x2.0 for the holder's acting capital area (0x497026), fistp, distance 0. The final cut pops the tail while more than one is left. Seen: Britain at the start of Ireland1939_09_06_18 ranks France's area alone at -1926 (309 provinces), Germany's capital area failed for touching France's.
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x495AFA-0x495C1E and 0x496B3E-0x497136 read on the running game; Britain's +0xC8 and +0x94 read from memory at 05:00 on 7 September 1939.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion(CEU3AI* ai, void* areasBeingInvaded, CAIUnit* agentOrNull)
addresses.comment: **Makes the CAIInvasion agents.** Read whole on the listing, 0x892190 to the one `ret 0xC` at 0x893C70. Callers: ProcessAI daily at hour id%24 for an AI-run country (agentOrNull = 0, 0x889AB5) and on even hours for each unit agent of the played country (0x889A39). (1) Gates: a played country needs an agent whose unit (slot 74) is set; an AI country needs agentOrNull = 0. Cap = 2 invasions, JAP 8, USA 4: an AI country with MORE than the cap plans nothing; the area loop stops once the count reaches it (no cap with an agent). While the strategy IsPreparingWar: for each Neighbours (+0xFD8) entry it IsPreparingWarWith, return unless we are major (CCountry::IsMajor: is_major or max_ic > 100) and the target is neither; and return while now < that WarTargets entry's date (+0x1C) plus one month. An AI country also returns when every ranked area (+0xC8) is already in areasBeingInvaded (PruneInvasions' list). With an agent, its +0x36C/+0x370 are zeroed. (2) Candidates, over CCountry +0xBAC in order: a unit with oob_level != 0, no agent of its own, whose topmost agent up +0x1E0 answers slot 65 (a CAIUnit) and is agentOrNull when one is given. A division (level 4): >= 2 brigades, not aboard (CArmy +0x300), its area real (slot 0), not landlocked (+0x68), and either in our acting capital's area or its region group (+0x6C) null or 0x80430 says that group borders no enemy; army_role not 5 or 8; organisation share (slot 26) >= 0.8 and strength share (slot 25) >= 0.75; then spare = CountDivisionsInArea(agent, area, , false) - (candidates already taken from that area) - need, need = EstimateAreaNeed(agent, area, , , true), halved (toward 0) in the acting capital's area unless COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea(area) or 0x817E0(area); taken when spare > 0 or army_role == 7. Any other non-theatre unit: a fleet (slot 16) carrying nothing (CNavy +0x2EC < 1) is a transport candidate. No division -> return. lift = UnitList_SumTransportCapacity(transport candidates) (0x1D66D0) - never reduced as invasions take fleets; ref = 4 x infantry_brigade weight/1000. (3) Over the ranked areas from the head, stopping at the cap or when lift < ref: skip ENG and NZL/CAN/SAF/AST's 'liberation' areas only for dominions before 1942 - the areas of provinces 2613 Paris, 2137 Brugge, 1910 Amsterdam make an ENG/dominion target 'special' in years <= 1941 (dominions skip every area before 1942); GER without an agent skips London's (1964) area in years <= 1942; skip an area in areasBeingInvaded. **The AreaIsConnectedTo test at 0x892B9E is dead**: it is asked of g_null_owner_area, whose slot 0 answers false. Enemy area (first-province controller IsEnemy, not special): N = max(CountEnemyUnitsInArea(strategy, area, false), 1); skip when N x ref > 2 x lift or candidates < N. Otherwise (special or not enemy-held): N = 1 + CountEnemyUnitsInArea(.., true) over neighbour areas whose controller is an enemy, minus 1 for each of our land units with army_role != 0 already in the area's region group, each land unit we lent the controller (+0x290) there, and each land unit with role != 0 of our invasions whose objective is in that group; the supply use of all of them summed into S; N capped at 5 (special) or 20; skip when N < 1. (4) Landing: enemy area, or one with no port -> PickInvasionLandingProvince(ai, area, 0) (null skips); capacity = NavalBaseCapacity(it) + for every port q of the area (the landing port among them) within ProvinceDistanceSquared < 160000.0: floor(((1.0 - d2/160000.0) x cap(q)/1000 + 0.0005) x 1000). Friendly area with ports: the port minimising DistanceBetweenProvinces(true capital, port) x 3000 / level_current (the distance itself at level 0), capacity = the sum of the friendly ports' NavalBaseCapacity, or the chosen port's own where it is not friendly. N' = N, x3 where the area is an enemy major's acting capital area and not special. (5) Divisions, one at a time while picked < N' and S <= capacity + 2000: the candidate minimising NavalDistance(first port of its area, landing)/1000, halved for army_role 7, doubled for 4, doubled again when its weight would take the total past lift (an AI country skips such a unit); not one whose destination is already in the area's region group, not army_role 3 or 5 for an enemy area. S += its SupplyConsumption; total and smallest weight kept. (6) Enemy area and total > lift: agent +0x36C += (total - lift)/(transport_ship capability/1000) + 1; total > 2 x lift abandons the area. picked < 1, or enemy area and picked < N: agent +0x370 += N - picked. (7) Fleets: escort target = 0.5 x total; repeat while chosen lift < total or escort power < target: a fleet every ship of which has strength share >= 0.75 and organisation share >= 0.8; d = NavalDistance(its province, landing)/1000 + 500; with transport ships it is a transport candidate while chosen lift < total, without them an escort while escort power < target, d x100 with a submarine, /3 with a carrier, else /2 with a battleship; the nearest of each is taken, escort power += GetPower(fleet)/1000 for both. (8) At least one transport fleet and chosen lift >= the smallest division's weight: new CAIInvasion(&ai->tag, landing, ai), pushed on +0x50, AddUnit for every division, transport and escort (each taken off the candidate lists), slot 7, slot 52 (Enable). Worker thread. **The friendly branch seen in play 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): Britain's invasion of France's area (special, holding Paris) lands at Cherbourg, the port nearest London, with the 1st Royal Marines alone - the home area well ported, so no other division spare - and two fleets.
addresses.evidence: Britain's CAIInvasion read from memory: objective 2422, port 1255, one land unit, two fleets; MoveUnit logged from stage 1 and stage 3.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::OnUnitBoarded
addresses.comment: **Slot 69**, and it is tiny: 0x4D5510 to the `ret 4` at 0x4D552D - ten instructions. It zeroes the word at `this[+0x2C8]` and tail-calls 0x4D42D0 with `this[+0x300]`. **Slot 71 (0x4D5530) abuts it with no int3 padding** - a fresh `push ebp; mov ebp,esp; push -1; push 0xC3CEB3` follows the `ret 4` immediately - so a padding-based walk reads the two as one function (trap 2). **It is the agent's answer to a unit boarding** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): CNavy::AddCarried calls it (0x1CF116) on the first agent up the fleet's hierarchy; the word it zeroes is the unit's ai_held_back and ai_garrison (+0x2C8/+0x2C9), and the sailing step it calls runs with the carried count already raised. Seen: Britain's 1st 'London' Division boarding the 4th Navy at Newcastle at 06:00 on 7 September 1939, the transport order to Lerwick issued in the same call.
addresses.evidence: Slot 69, CAIUnit_SailTransportOrWait and CEU3AI::IssueUnitOrder logged on the running game; the listing 0x4D5510-0x4D552D read.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_SailTransportOrWait
addresses.comment: Called from CAIUnit slot 69 (0x4D5510) and from 0x4C745B. At 0x4D454E it calls GetDefines and reads `[+0xAC][+0x1E4]` - **military.STRAT_REDEP_BASE_SPEED** - divided by 1000.0, but only on the branch where a virtual it has just called answers the save token **0x5A4**, the id CStrategicRedeploymentOrder carries. So it is estimating how long a move will take, with the strategic-redeployment speed used when the unit would redeploy rather than march. The name is from that shape; the body was not read in full. **Renamed 2026-11-14: it is the sealift's sailing step** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 84), `ret 8`, (agent, transport). Read as far as its decision: nothing unless the fleet's +0x2EC is above 0 and the agent's unit's plan has embark (+0x284) and debark (+0x288); over the agent's land units (+0x11C) whose target (+0x2E8) is debark and whose anchor area is embark's: all their brigades (+0x40), those aboard (CArmy +0x300), whether any not aboard fits the transports' room (this fleet's capability less what it carries, plus the agent's other transports'), whether any has +0x1EC above 0, and the least hours any not aboard that fits this fleet needs to reach embark - its definition's speed (+0x108), or under a strategic redeployment (0x5A4) STRAT_REDEP_BASE_SPEED scaled - by CMap distance. Everyone aboard: sail. One who fits: nothing where the fleet's slot 34 refuses debark, else sail only where that one is further off than 0x120A4C8. None who fits: sail where slot 34 accepts debark. Sailing: CEU3AI::IssueUnitOrder(transport 0x3A8, or invasion 0x3A5 by debark's area, 0x4D4C89-0x4D4D19, fleet, debark), answering true. The arm for a fleet slot 34 refuses (0x4D470F on, escorts and the plan's +0x210) is not read. The STRAT_REDEP_BASE_SPEED read the old name came from is the march estimate. **Its far threshold** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): the double at 0x120A4C8 is 50.0 - a unit still to come more than 50 hours off is not waited for. Seen called from CAIUnit::OnUnitBoarded at once on a boarding, its transport order issued in the same hour.
addresses.evidence: The double read from memory; the call logged on the running game.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea(CAIUnit* agent, CUnit* unit, COwnerArea* area)
addresses.comment:
**Whether a unit may be given (or keep) a target in an area** - in effect, whether it has to cross water or hostile ground to get there. False when the area's region group (+0x6C, one side's land in one piece) is the group of the area of the unit's current province; when the area of its destination (or position) is real and landlocked (+0x68) or portless (+0x50 < 1) and CMapProvince::CanUnitReach(area's first province, unit, 1, 1) fails; when that destination is enemy-held, the unit CUnit::IsHoldingGround, retreats, or CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, 1, 1) refuses; when the area is enemy-held and army_role is 0 or 5; when it is not and army_role is 3 or 4 and (area +0x3C < 1 and it is not the acting capital's area, or the unit's own area COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea). Otherwise AreaPair_SeaRouteOpen(own area, country, area). `ret 0xC`. Ghidra calls it CNullOwnerArea::CNullOwnerArea_3. Two callers in AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift (VA 0x8C584E keep-or-release, 0x8C5F98 candidates).

**It never tests the area's province count (+0x2C)**: it reads the head of `area`'s province list and dereferences it at 0x8C427B-0x8C4281 (for CanUnitReach, behind a slot-0 test of the destination's area, not this one) and at 0x8C42DB-0x8C42E1, unguarded. The keep-or-release caller (0x8C584E) passes the area of the unit's saved target with no test of its own, so a land unit bound for a province in no area - the CNullOwnerArea, empty - is a null read at rva 0x4C42E1. That is the load crash of 2026-11-02: two role-5 divisions, SOV's 27-y Ukrepl'onnyy Rayon bound for Leningrad (782) and CHI's Hubei Silingbu for Shanghai (5542), both put in no area by BlackICE's extra_infra. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-extrainfra.md. **Seen in play 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): a unit aboard at sea stands in the null area, whose AreaPair_SeaRouteOpen has no port at war, so it answers false and the keep-or-release drops the target - Britain's 1st 'London' Division at 10539 at 09:00 on 7 September 1939, bound for Lerwick.
addresses.evidence: The answer read after the call at 0x4C584E on the running game.

addresses.name: COwnerArea_IsWellPorted
addresses.comment: True when the area's ports' naval bases' level_current, summed and divided by its province count (both thousandths), exceed floor(500.5) = 500 - more than half a naval base level per province. False for an area with no provinces. Its one caller is PlanAmphibiousInvasion (0x8927CB), where it stops the halving of the acting capital area's division need. The name is ours. **Seen to matter 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): Britain's home area at the war's start is well ported, so the invasion planner keeps its whole division need and only marines are candidates.
addresses.evidence: Inferred from the planner's candidates as read in memory (one land unit) and OpenHOI3's reproduction with the test.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::OnUnitEnteredProvince
addresses.comment: **CAIUnit slot 71: the agent told that a land unit has stepped into a province.** 0x4D5530 to the `ret 4` at 0x4D562C (and 0x4D5667). Called by CUnit::AdvanceMovement (0x1CB04C) on every entry into a province, on the unit's own agent (the first AI agent up its hierarchy, where it is a unit agent). Where the unit's previous province (+0x134) is not simulated (template +0x22 clear): +0x5C set. Nothing more where the unit has no target (CArmy +0x2E8 <= 0). Where the target's area is the area of the province it now stands in: the agent's reassign_areas_now (+0x5C) set, so the sealift runs in the next hour. Otherwise, with no path left (+0x140 < 1), not carried (CArmy +0x300) and standing on the plan's embark (the agent's unit's +0x284): CAIUnit_BoardUnitAtEmbark(agent, unit). Seen: Britain's 1st 'London' Division into 1299 and into Newcastle, the second boarding it (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89).
addresses.evidence: The listing 0x4D5530-0x4D5667 read on the running game; the slot and its caller logged.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_BoardUnitAtEmbark
addresses.comment: **A land unit at the plan's embark port put aboard one of the agent's transports there.** 0x4D4070 to the `ret 8` at 0x4D41E6 (false) and 0x4D42CB (true); the arguments on the stack, ECX unused. False where the unit is carried (CArmy +0x300), where the agent's unit's plan lacks embark (+0x284) or debark (+0x288), or the unit does not stand on embark. Over the embark province's units (+0x2B8) in order: a fleet (slot 16) whose first AI agent up its hierarchy (+0x198, then +0x1E0's) is this agent, that can carry the unit (0x71EFB0) and is on the agent's naval transport list (+0xEC): a CLoadUnitCommand (0x8C bytes, constructor 0x733A20(unit, fleet)) posted on the session's queue, the fleet's +0x2CA set, true. Called by CAIUnit::OnUnitEnteredProvince and AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift (0x4C7109). Not part of CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits, whose extent ends at 0x4D3EA1 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89).
addresses.evidence: The listing read on the running game; the call logged for Britain's 1st 'London' Division at Newcastle.

struct_fields.name: ai_pass_scratch
struct_fields.comment: Zeroed by slot 78 at the top of every unit iteration (0x4B2104) and not read anywhere in slot 78, 79, 0x4B60F0 or 0x4B82F0. Either a flag a later slot consumes or dead. Also set to 1 on a fleet by CAIUnit_BoardUnitAtEmbark (0x4D42B6) as it posts a unit's load onto it (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89).
struct_fields.evidence: The listing of CAIUnit_BoardUnitAtEmbark read on the running game (mov byte ptr [esi+0x2CA],1 at 0x4D42B6).
